//: Java particle types not replaced one for one: Java spawns many particles for one game event where Bedrock starts the effect once, so one Bedrock effect per Java particle would multiply it. These need an event-level bridge.
minecraft:crit: Java spawns a burst of crit particles per hit (a tracking emitter); critical_hit_emitter is a steady emitter of its own, once per hit
minecraft:dust_pillar: Java spawns many dust pillar particles per mace smash; smash_ground_particle emits 500 per smash and reads the ground block's texture
minecraft:effect: Java spawns ~100 effect particles per splash potion; splash_spell_emitter emits 100 per splash
minecraft:instant_effect: Java spawns ~100 per instant splash potion; mobspell_emitter is per potion
minecraft:item: Java spawns item-break particles one by one; breaking_item_icon emits v.num_particles per break and reads the item texture
minecraft:totem_of_undying: Java's totem is a tracking emitter of many particles; the Bedrock effect is once per totem use
minecraft:geyser_base: Bedrock reads the geyser's active_time and plume_height, which a Java particle does not carry
minecraft:geyser_plume: Bedrock reads the geyser's active_time and plume_height, which a Java particle does not carry
minecraft:geyser_poof: Bedrock reads the geyser's plume_height, which a Java particle does not carry
